name: redis
title: Redis
author: yunix-intel
description:
龙芯版说明

架构：linux/loong64（仅龙芯 3A5000/3A6000）

与上游差异：openEuler 7.2.14 包；AOF+RDB。

缺失功能：默认 protected-mode no，必须配密码或限制网络。

额外依赖：6379；持久化 /data。

镜像说明：7.2.14（openEuler 包）；AOF+RDB；`/data`；6379；默认 protected-mode no，公网必须设 `REDIS_PASSWORD`；UID/GID 998:996
description_en:
LoongArch notes

Architecture: linux/loong64 only

Differences: openEuler 7.2.14 package; AOF+RDB.

Missing features: protected-mode is off by default; set a password or restrict the network.

Extra dependencies: Port 6379; persist /data.

Image notes: 7.2.14（openEuler 包）；AOF+RDB；`/data`；6379；默认 protected-mode no，公网必须设 `REDIS_PASSWORD`；UID/GID 998:996

notes: 未在 OpenWrt/iStoreOS 真机上执行安装回归；仅做 ipk 结构与 JSON schema 静态校验。
